messages.subject: error running timeShiftImages
parts:
Hi,

One of my cameras was accidentally set to 01.01.2017 so am currently trying to run the timeShiftImages function but I keep getting an error 'there is more than 1 space in your timeShiftColumn string. Only 1 space is allowed'. Not sure where I'm going wrong. This is my console below and I have also attached the csv of my timeShiftTable in case I've done that wrong:

timeshift_run <- timeShiftImages(inDir = wd_images_fg1a,

+                                  timeShiftTable = timeshift_1a ,

+                                  stationCol = 'ï..Station',

+                                  hasCameraFolders = FALSE,

+                                  timeShiftColumn ='timeshift',

+                                  timeShiftSignColumn = 'sign',

+                                  undo = FALSE )

Error in timeShiftImages(inDir = wd_images_fg1a, timeShiftTable = timeshift_1a,  :

  there is more than 1 space in your timeShiftColumn string. Only 1 space is allowed ( FG-1A )

> str(timeshift_1a)

'data.frame':      1 obs. of  4 variables:

 $ ï..Station: chr "FG-1A"

 $ Camera    : logi NA

 $ timeshift : chr "5:4:18:12:7:0"

 $ sign      : chr "+"

> class(timeshift_1a)

[1] "data.frame"



Thanks in advance!
